# 2 bed apartment for sale

> MMWard Estate Agents are delighted to introduce No. 61 The Watersedge, a spacious two bedroom ground floor apartment situated in the highly sought after Oldtown Demesne development. Set within meticulously maintained communal grounds, this well positioned apartment enjoys pleasant views over the local playing fields and benefits from private parking.

- Lokalita: Apt 61 Watersedge, Oldtown Demense, Naas
